title: augment_usage_errors attaches ctx/param to errors
answers: Why do parse errors include usage line and param name?
Where is ctx added to BadParameter/UsageError?
body: core.py:augment_usage_errors is a context manager that catches BadParameter/UsageError, fills missing e.ctx (and e.param for BadParameter), and re-raises. Used in Parameter.handle_parse_result (value consumption, type conversion, param callbacks) and Context.invoke (`with augment_usage_errors(self): with ctx: return callback(...)`). Raising these without ctx in callbacks/types is therefore fine.
